## Review checklist
- [ ] Changes only within the assigned workstream directory
- [ ] No edit to shared AGENTS/docs/registry or another worker's files
- [ ] No private Drive links/IDs, secrets, commercial ebooks or redistributed PDFs
- [ ] No invented sources/DOIs/page numbers/reviews/measurements
- [ ] Original analytical writing and short, attributable excerpts only
- [ ] Source verification scope explicitly stated
- [ ] Readback confirms committed files exist remotely
- [ ] Private Google Sheets Master Catalog **not written by child**
- [ ] PR targets `main`; **main coordination chat performs the merge**
